messages:
maya: quick update — rolled v2q3-int4 to a 5% canary on chat-v1. initial 30m snapshot: p50 +8ms, p95 +25ms, token cost down ~33%. overall nDCG ~-0.24% but code-hallucination slice shows +1.6% absolute. thinking fallback rule: if slice delta >1% abs OR overall nDCG drop >0.5% => auto-fallback. thoughts? cc @raj @simon

deploy-bot: canary started: v2q3-int4 @5% on chat-v1 — will post metric pings every 15m.

raj: fwiw +1% on code hallucination feels small but user-impactful. prefer hard gate: any hallucination increase >0.8% on top-10 code-gen queries => immediate rollback. also require a paired t-test p < 0.05 before auto-fallback.

simon: agree on statistical test but add smoothing: require signal to be sustained for 2 consecutive 15m windows OR cumulative z-score > 2.5. avoids noisy single-window flips.

miguel-ml: also add long-context slice (>2048 tokens). int4 runs we saw earlier had KV-cache jitter causing +0.9% bad terminations on longctx. recommend slice-aware weighting (e.g. hallucination_slice_weight *2) in the gating score.

lara-eng: ops ask — can we gate with a low-cost smokecheck too? run 100 deterministic smoke prompts from the smoke corpus; require 0% regression on exact-match tasks and <=0.5% on fuzzier metrics. failing that blocks promotion.

maya: good calls. I'll update rollout config: staged promotion 5% -> 20% over 12h with automatic pause if any slice triggers. add manual notify to #oncall-sre when stat-test p < 0.01.

simon: addendum — add a 30m grace window for warmup. don't count the first window toward auto-fallback.

deploy-bot: canary metrics (30m): p50 +8ms, p95 +27ms, overall nDCG -0.24%, code_hallucination +1.48% (p=0.03), longctx_bad_term +0.7%.

maya: that p=0.03 crosses raj's p<0.05 cutoff, but per simon's sustained rule we need 2 windows. hold for next ping.

miguel-ml: ran a 2k-sample shadow eval on longctx — raw diffs show hallucination +1.6%, but skewed toward prompts containing stack traces. could be dataset artifact; recommend rerun with trace-stripping normalization.

lara-eng: ops note — GPU memory pressure on canary hosts spiked ~12% during the 2nd window. might be unrelated but correlated. SRE @soren can you look?

soren: checking now. GPU mem bump aligns with a recent batch-size tweak in the pod template; I reverted that change. watching for next window.

maya: pushing proposed rollout config to the rollout service; snippet below (will be checked into infra):

```json
{
  "phases": [ { "pct": 5, "min_run": "30m" }, { "pct": 20, "min_run": "6h" } ],
  "auto_fallback": {
    "metrics": [ { "name": "code_hallucination", "abs_delta": 0.8, "stat_p": 0.05, "sustained_windows": 2 } ],
    "grace_window": "30m",
    "slice_weights": { "long_context": 2 }
  }
}
```

simon: :thumbsup: please add a short doc note about the 'trace-stripping' normalization we talked about for longctx samples so future evals are comparable.

maya: will do. if auto-rollback trips I'll open a follow-up thread with root-cause details. thanks everyone — will post the 45m and 60m pings here.
